title: IDOR Security Audit: verify user_id ownership checks in ALL handlers — FishBot
description:
## Task: Complete IDOR Audit — FishBot

### What is IDOR?
Insecure Direct Object Reference — when a user can access another user's data
by changing an ID in a callback. Example: `catch_view_999` where 999 is someone else's catch.

### Correct pattern
```python
# SECURE — always filter by user_id too:
result = await session.execute(
    select(Catch).where(Catch.id == catch_id, Catch.user_id == user.id)
)
```

### Files to audit (all handlers that access DB objects by ID)
```
bot/handlers/catch.py     — catch_view_, catch_edit_, clone_catch_, trophy_card_, qr_catch_
bot/handlers/gear.py      — gear_view_, gear_trip_, gear_st_, gear_del_, line_trip_, line_reset_
bot/handlers/bait.py      — bait_edit_, bait_del_, bait_use_
bot/handlers/traps.py     — check_trap_, trap_del_
bot/handlers/licenses.py  — lic_view_, lic_del_
bot/handlers/places.py    — place_view_, place_del_
bot/handlers/expenses.py  — exp_edit_, exp_del_
bot/handlers/contacts.py  — contact_edit_, contact_del_
bot/handlers/group_fishing.py — grp_view_, grp_kick_, grp_leaderboard_
bot/handlers/session.py   — session_view_, session_close_
bot/handlers/social.py    — social_view_
```

### Workflow
1. Request full code from poster.
2. Check EVERY handler that parses an ID from callback_data and queries DB.
3. Verify each has: `Model.user_id == user.id` (or equivalent) in the WHERE clause.

### Deliverable
```
| File | Handler | Callback Pattern | SECURE/VULNERABLE | Fix (if vulnerable) |
```
Every row = one handler checked. If vulnerable, provide the fix.
